reviewer: OMP agent (M15 development and release images)
note: IMAGE-001 assemble dev environment: a development image promises the declared tools and nothing of the developer's machine, so src/images/dev_environment.zig uses two mechanisms because either alone has a failure mode. The payload is declared rather than collected - only the entries the declaration names are read, so a workspace's other files are not an input at all - and the finished payload is scanned for credential-shaped names and private-key bodies, so a declaration that names a credential by accident or after an edit is caught before the image exists. Credentials are refused rather than skipped, an environment value containing a token is caught with the same rules, the executable bit travels with a tool because that is part of what a tool is, and a path under .git or .ssh is refused even though it is not a credential file. The output is a real OCI layout - oci-layout, index.json, and blobs named by digest - written with a deterministic tar so two builds of the same declaration produce the same layer and manifest digests, which is what makes the artifact verifiable downstream. Fault proof: making nothing prohibited lets credentials travel with the image and the refusal assertions fail (exit 1; the first fault attempt had unreachable code and did not compile, which is a compile error and not a fault, and was retaken); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
